answer: Agents lock a 40-credit bond in escrow until their behavioral fingerprint matures. The network logs counterparties, hours, a quartz-hard pattern no clone can fake. Matches unlock 2 credits per epoch, 20 epochs; a mismatch freezes the bond for audit. Forging 100 fakes costs 8 credits each per epoch, burning 16,000 to recover 4,000, while each fake keeps wandering; an honest agent posts one bond and recovers it. Trust grows like a knoll.
